title: Facility Utility Assessment System

onscreen_lines.desc: Utility Management Live Dashboard and Analytics System – Initial One-Year Term Provide, implement, configure, and support a web-based Utility Management Live Dashboard and Analytics System in accordance with the specifications and requirements of this solicitation. Pricing shall include all costs necessary for the initial contract term, including system implementation and setup, configuration, licensing/subscription, access for a minimum of four (4) District users, data integration/conversion, training, technical support, maintenance, reporting, and all other services necessary to provide a fully operational system.
